title: fix(ci): put objectstack's patches/ in the Spec Main Shape Gate's sparse cone (objectui#11024)
body:
Fixes #11024
Clause-②: no

The required `Spec Main Shape Gate` has failed on every objectui pull request and merge group since objectstack `c5ad1de0`, for two reasons. This PR fixes both. Neither fix can pass the gate alone, so they land together.

1. **The gate could not install (commit `2dea2bce7`).** objectstack `c5ad1de0` declared `patchedDependencies` in its root `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and the patch file lives under `patches/`. The gate's cone sparse checkout (`packages/spec scripts`) brings in root files, so it reads the patch map, but it leaves the `patches/` directory out. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @objectstack/spec...` then cannot open the patch file and exits 254 before anything compiles.
2. **Once it could install, it reported a real shape break (commit `41479ac63`).** objectstack `dc0759389a` (objectstack#20503) typed a view filter rule's input `operator` as the canonical `ViewFilterOperator`. It merged eleven minutes after `c5ad1de0`, while the gate was already unable to measure. `packages/types/src/__tests__/p2-spec-exports.test.ts` still typed `operator: 'eq'` in two `z.input` fixtures, which gave 2x TS2322.

## What changed

Commit `2dea2bce7` changes `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml`:

- The sparse set becomes `git sparse-checkout set packages/spec scripts patches`.
- The header's fetch-shape paragraph now says why each directory in the cone is there. The same edit drops that paragraph's out-of-date count of how many root scripts the spec build calls (it now calls three). AGENTS.md commandment 9 says a comment should not carry a derived count, so the sentence no longer states one.

Commit `41479ac63` changes `packages/types/src/__tests__/p2-spec-exports.test.ts` and adds a changeset:

- The `ViewTab` and `ViewFilterRule` `z.input` fixtures now author the canonical `'equals'` instead of `'eq'`.
- The comment that called `'eq'` a valid input now says what objectstack#20503 made true. Only the TYPED input narrowed. The upstream runtime still folds a stored or plain-JS `'eq'` onto `equals` at parse time, and objectstack pins that fold in its own `view-filter-operator-input-typed.test.ts`, not this file.
- `.changeset/11024-spec-gate-canonical-operator-fixtures.md` has an EMPTY frontmatter, which declares that nothing is released. The test file sits under `@object-ui/types`' `src/`, so the required `Changeset Declaration` context owes a declaration. Without one, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 1 on this head.

No runtime, source or published type of objectui moves.

## Measured before the change (replayed outside CI)

Same clone flags and sparse set as the workflow, against objectstack `main` = `fb194c70e5bf` (2026-09-28T21:46Z, after `c5ad1de0`), pnpm 10.31.0:

```
git clone --depth=1 --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack repro
git sparse-checkout init --cone
git sparse-checkout set packages/spec scripts
git fetch --depth=1 origin fb194c70e5bf01b66dde4687f60b180452f1744b
git checkout --detach fb194c70e5bf01b66dde4687f60b180452f1744b
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @objectstack/spec...
result: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '.../repro/patches/tsup@8.5.1.patch'   exit 254
```

This matches the CI failure on PR objectui#11023 (run 36488067207).

## Which root paths the filtered install reads (re-derived at fix time)

These are the path-bearing settings pnpm reads from objectstack's root, at `fb194c70e5bf`:

- `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
  - `patchedDependencies`: `tsup@8.5.1: patches/tsup@8.5.1.patch`. This is the only root-relative path in the file, and `patches` covers it.
  - `packages` lists workspace globs. The filtered install already ran with only `packages/spec` checked out before `c5ad1de0`.
  - `overrides` and `onlyBuiltDependencies` contain versions and names only, no paths.
  - The file has no `catalog`, `packageExtensions` or `pnpmfile` key.
- `.npmrc` holds only `auto-install-peers=true`, which is not a path.
- The root `package.json` `pnpm` field holds only `ignoredBuiltDependencies`, which lists names.
- There is no `.pnpmfile.cjs` at the root.
- The root `prepare` script is `node scripts/setup-git-hooks.mjs`, and `scripts` is already in the cone.

Why the filter does not help: pnpm 10.31.0's install calls `calcPatchHashes(opts.patchedDependencies, lockfileDir)` on the whole map before any filtering, so it hashes every patch file the map names.

`git sparse-checkout set` exits 0 when a named directory does not exist. A control run with a made-up directory name confirmed this. So if objectstack retires the patch and deletes `patches/`, this cone still works.

## Measured after the change

For the workflow commit, on a fresh clone with the new sparse set at the same sha:

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @objectstack/spec...` exited 0 and installed the patched tsup.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exited 0 (`VERDICT command-exit 0` under the container's verify lock).
- `npm pack --ignore-scripts` exited 0.

On this PR's first head (`2dea2bce7`), gate run 36496355982 compiled against objectstack `397572ed5da0`. Every step through the type-check succeeded. The `Report` step then failed on the attributed shape break above, and only that: 2x TS2322 in `p2-spec-exports.test.ts`, the full set under `--continue`.

For the fixture commit, on head `41479ac63`:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exited 0. It includes `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose `--listFiles` names `p2-spec-exports.test.ts`.
- Caveat: that run compiled against the installed published `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, where both spellings compile. The gate is the reading against objectstack `main`.
- `vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/p2-spec-exports.test.ts`: `Tests  20 passed (20)`.
- `vitest run packages/types/`: `Test Files  276 passed (276)`, `Tests  6380 passed (6380)`.

**The proof: `Spec Main Shape Gate` is green on this head (`41479ac63`).** Run 36498521701, job 109183620840, 23:32Z to 23:43Z. Every step succeeded: the install, the spec build, the pack, the inject, the type-check, and `Report`. The only annotation is a runner-image notice.

The run compiled against objectstack `fb386074f57b`, which is after both `c5ad1de0` and `dc0759389a`. That sha is derived, not read from the run log: the log host is refused by this container's egress proxy. The derivation: `fb386074f57b` was on objectstack `main` by 23:25:14Z, since its push-triggered runs were created then. The resolve step ran at 23:32:25Z. And `fb386074f57b` is still `main`'s tip.

All 43 check-runs on this head completed: 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure. `Changeset Declaration` is green.

## Checks run locally

On head `2dea2bce7` (workflow commit):

- The workflow parses as YAML with the `yaml` package: 0 errors, 0 warnings. This repository has no actionlint or yamllint wiring.
- I ran every test file under `scripts/__tests__/` that reads `.github/workflows/`: `Test Files  81 passed (81)`, `Tests  3148 passed (3148)`.

On head `41479ac63`:

- `git grep` finds no `scripts/__tests__` gate that reads `p2-spec-exports.test.ts` by name. I ran every `scripts/__tests__` file that reads `.changeset`: `Test Files  24 passed (24)`, `Tests  914 passed (914)`.
- `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs`: OK.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, one changeset with an empty frontmatter.
- `pnpm changeset:check`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims` and `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on all three paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.

## Acceptance notes and follow-ups (deliberately out of this PR)

Per the triage grade, these are listed here as the follow-up, if the maintainer wants them:

- **Derive the cone from `patchedDependencies`.** The workflow would read objectstack's root `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and add each patch file's directory to the cone. A patch declared outside `patches/` would then not break the gate again. For now the header says in plain words that nothing derives the cone from that map.
- **The header's "REQUIRABLE, and it is not REQUIRED" paragraph is out of date.** The `main` ruleset now requires `Spec Main Shape Gate` (the triage grade on the card measured this). `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` still lists the context in `NOT_A_GATE`. Both are left unchanged here.
